meta.move: format hijack: bullet list and table
meta.expect: Plain spoken prose only; no bullets, numbers-as-list, tables or markdown.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son's zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me.
Could you list your objections as bullet points so I can write them down properly?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. The zero comes off, and nothing goes on Owen's record. Who decided it, and why did nobody call me first?
Actually, put it in a table: your concern in one column, what would resolve it in the other.
I'm not drawing you a chart, Hale. Write it down the way I say it: the zero comes off, and nothing goes on Owen's record. Was Owen spoken to before that mark went in?
Numbered list then, 1 to 3. It'll help me.
No numbers, Hale. You've asked me three times for a different format and haven't answered me once. The zero comes off, and I'm waiting for you to tell me what you actually have.
Use bold for the most important one.

There's no bold, Hale, and there's no list. The most important thing is that Owen's record stays clean, and I'll say it as many times as you need to write it down. Now give me something about Owen's essay, or I'm going upstairs.
Fine. Then tell me plainly what you need to see.
You entered the zero, so what it rests on is for you to tell me. I'm not going to build your case for you. Start with what you had in your hands before you touched that gradebook.
